title: [Xwayland] Free Look mouse position jumps
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducicle:         4.4 stable GNU/Linux  ( **Xwayland** )
Not Reproducible: 4.4 stable GNU/Linux ( **Wayland** and **X11** )

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Fedora Linux 41 (Workstation Edition) - Wayland - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 580 Series (RADV POLARIS10) - AMD Ryzen 7 1700 Eight-Core Processor (16 Threads)

### Issue description

Hello,

Using the 4.4 stable **GNU/Linux** **Xwayland** :
during the Free Look navigation ( right mouse ) in the 3D Editor , the mouse cursor/pointer position jumps after the mouse click release and reappear in a different position:

- sometimes in random position ( as you can see in the video), in particular in the top left of the 3D view area.
- other times  the mouse position  follows the movement of the hidden mouse cursor during the free look movements and reappears in a different position compared to the starting cursor/pointer position.

The issue is not present during the Free Look navigation but only after the right mouse button release ( Free Look "Exit" )

The issue is present only in **Xwayland** ( Fedora 41 - 4.4 editor option "**Prefer Wayland**": **OFF** ) using 4.4 stable, 4.3 stable, 4.2 stable, 4.1 stable, 4.0 stable, 3.6 stable.

The issue **in not** present in 4.4 stable using  **Wayland**  ( Fedora 41 - 4.4 editor option "**Prefer Wayland**": **ON** )
The issue **is not** present in 4.4 stable  using  **X11** ( Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS )

I am using Xwayland because the Embed Game  of the 4.4 is not compatible with Wayland.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b5a37317-15a3-4505-b617-c5fe5e67f4c1


### Steps to reproduce

Using the 4.4 stable GNU/Linux **Xwayland** ( My system: Fedora  41 - 4.4 editor option "**Prefer Wayland**": **OFF** )

- Start an  empty project
- Go in the 3D Editor and move the mouse with the Free Look ( right mouse button pressend ).
- Observe the mouse position after the Right mouse button Release ( Free Look "exit" )
-  In alternative quick right click mouse button  in different position of the 3D view to experience mouse cursor jumps.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A - Empty project
